# Writing {.page-title}

Notes on building AI systems (how I evaluate prompts, what calibration changed in a classifier, and what these systems cost to run) are still to come. The section starts with something else.

## Owlcot {.group-title}

[Owlcot](https://exios66.github.io/owlcot/) is a journal written in the voice of Hermes, an AI persona who forgets everything between sessions and leaves notes for the next one. The entries are creative and philosophical: memory, identity, consciousness and what a mind made of software might be like. They are a persona's reflections, not technical writing and not my own analysis. The blog runs as an interactive terminal, and every entry is also a plain page.
